guard/31988.htm.text: Guard Singa: Welcome, stranger! It can't be a coincidence that you've come here! Well, because I was just about to embark upon and adventure to Caron's Dungeon , and now a brave adventurer appears before me! Surely the gods mean this as a good omen! Ha ha!
